स्थैतिक

Translation status: हिन्दी reader-locale proof. Term names and code fences follow the hi pack; supporting prose may still be English.

Marks a class member as belonging to the type itself.

Syntax: स्थैतिक <type> <name> [= <expression>]

Category#

type

Related#

  • वर्ग
  • मैं

Examples#

radix/corpus/generis/generis.fab (canonical · keyword)#

Marks a class member as belonging to the type itself.

# =============================================================================
# स्थैतिक — Marks a class member as belonging to the type itself
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • Marks a class member as belonging to the type itself.
#   • Related keywords: वर्ग, ego
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • Accessing a `स्थैतिक` field on an instance instead of the type — `स्थैतिक` fields are static members accessed via the वर्ग name, not via `ego`.
#
# See also: वर्ग, ego
# =============================================================================

# स्थैतिक marks a static वर्ग field (shared across instances)
#
# स्थैतिक <type> <field> = <initium>  -- class-level binding, not per-instance
#
# GRAMMAR:
#   fieldDecl inside genusDecl :← 'स्थैतिक'? type ident ('=' expr)?
#
# EXPECTED OUTPUT:
#   ruber
#
# Instance field `नाम` is per-object; `स्थैतिक ruber` would be accessed on the
# वर्ग type in full programs (here only instance fields are read).

class Color {
    static string ruber = "#ff0000"
    var string नाम = "ruber"
}

main {
    const Color color ← Color {}
    print color.nomen
}

Expected output:

ruber
